name: @exyconn/payout
description: Where money is paid out to: salary and refund accounts by method (bank transfer, UPI, PayPal, Wise, Payoneer, Western Union) with the ISO rules each country uses — IBAN (ISO 13616) with mod-97 check digits, BIC (ISO 9362), ISO 3166 countries, ISO 4217 currencies and local routing codes (IFSC, ABA, sort code, BSB). One definition shared by the portal forms (from source) and the portal server (from the compiled dist).
